originals.ko: 그게 작동하지 않으면 우리는 그냥 바꿀 필요가 있어
originals.why: This line does not contain the LEGO 'dydy o ddim angen'. Its only 'angen' is in 'dan ni jesd angen', so it does not practise this LEGO.

topups.why: Weaker than the others: '아니 그는 필요 없어' reads as a finished statement, not an open infinitive. It is not needed because three better BUILD rows are kept.

refill.ko: 아니, 그는 그 남자에 대해 이야기를 쓸 필요가 없어

refill.why: Only 2 USE slots are needed. This row is fine with 왜 그는 절반을 낼 필요가 없어?, but U07 and U04 are stronger.
Only 2 USE slots are needed, and 나는 행복해 왜냐하면 … 없어 sounds stiff in Korean. 이사하다 also narrows symud, which can mean any kind of moving.

originals.ko: 나는 어디서 ~를 살 수 있어?
originals.why: 'brynu' is the soft mutation of 'prynu', used in the same sense. '~를' marks the open object and keeps '살' from being read as 살다 (to live).

originals.ko: 나는 ~를 살 수 있어
originals.why: Same word, mutated. The open '~를' keeps the 'buy' meaning clear.

originals.ko: 나는 그걸 살 수 있어
나는 어디서 무언가를 살 수 있어?
나는 그녀에게 그걸 사 달라고 부탁할 거야
originals.why: Natural North Welsh. Here gofyn means asking someone to do something, so it is rendered as a request (사 달라고 부탁하다) rather than the question sense of the 묻다 gloss.

originals.ko: 네가 나에게 다른 것을 사 주지 않으면
originals.why: Natural Welsh. Same verb, same sense.

네 차를 사다

topups.why: A fragment that is weaker than the full-sentence rows, and the 3 BUILD slots are already filled.
Good, but the 5 USE slots are already filled. It is also long, and its Korean clause order is reversed from the Welsh.

originals.ko: 올해 나는 ~하고 싶어
나는 올해 바빠

올해 다른 나라로 이사하다
그는 올해 알아낼 거야
정말 고마워 하지만 나는 올해 바빠
